founder.name: Beau Carnes
founder.title: Founder, Stilt Walker & Stilt Juggler
founder.headline: Built by an Actual Stilt Walker & Juggler — Not a Faceless Gig Conglomerate
founder.shortBio: From juggling clubs on stilts along waterfront tall-ship docks to working summer street parades in stars-and-stripes stilt trousers, I've lived the real logistics of elevated performance—and built the platform I wished existed.
storyParagraphs: When you actually walk and juggle on stilts at street festivals, parades, and waterfront events, you learn things generic gig websites never think about. You know why hem height on custom stilt pants has to clear the asphalt by 1.5 inches, why a gust of wind off the water changes how you toss clubs or wear a cape, and why a sturdy mounting bench in the staging area saves your knees.

I created StiltWalker.net so event planners can book vetted stilt performers filtered by real physical specs (ceiling clearance, stilt apparatus, juggling/specialty skills, and $1M COI insurance)—and so fellow stilt walkers, haunt actors, and builders get honest gear reviews and 0%-commission bookings.
